name: Gondwana
description: The southern supercontinent Jambhudweep was fused to in deep time, before the seas divided it.
notes: Named as the setting of the Fang vs Scale wars. Canon had no entity for it, which is why the source document filed that event under `region_shattered_sea` -- a region that exists, and is not where the war happened. A place canon can point at is the fix.
